independent_origins.claim: Copy every static Data array attributed by the pinned Swift fixture to meshcore_py/cayennelpp. The original Python generator/library version is not available in this snapshot; regeneration with that library is not claimed.

Copy explicit endian, high-bit, truncation and frame literals together with their exact source-case assertions. Input fixtures and expected-byte fixtures have distinct roles; their presence does not prove any candidate parser or crypto implementation.

Compile unchanged production envelope, compression, errors, enums and exact stored-property/Codable fragments on isolated macOS. Swift-produced JSON/compressed exports and executed assertion evidence are oracle outputs, never mock expected JSON.

protocol_version_policy: pinned-reference-snapshot identifies the exact source revision. Do not invent a meshcore_py or firmware semantic version absent from the original fixture.

preservation.regeneration: An explicit --regenerate copies the same frozen independent inputs. Check mode never rewrites files. Missing paths/blobs, changed reference bytes, duplicate IDs, invalid bytes, count/digest mismatches and zero fixtures are blocking failures.
preservation.admission: New expected vectors require independent source/oracle provenance, real assertions and review. Changing expected bytes to match candidate Kotlin, unreviewed source advancement, auto-updating goldens and lowered thresholds are forbidden.
preservation.candidate_expected_packets: Never call candidate Kotlin code to generate protocol expectations.
preservation.comparison: Protocol bytes compare exactly. Backup comparisons use decoded semantics, not compressed-byte identity.

backup_contract.date_encoding: Foundation JSONEncoder/JSONDecoder secondsSince1970, including fractional seconds
backup_contract.compression: The exact pinned NSData/Compression .zlib implementation, not ZIP/GZIP
backup_contract.legacy_fields: Keep source decodeIfPresent defaults and required fields; the oracle exercises actual codecs.
backup_contract.future_gate: WP-203 must supply actual Kotlin exports to the Swift decoder and consume real Swift exports through Android restore. Transactional database restore, deduplication and radio remapping are pending; WP-004 does not certify them.

licenses.oracle: No added third-party Python oracle library, external data upload, model or service.
